thread:
marie_partners: Partner ask came in: they want an end-to-end example that covers a tiny reference arch, publishable Terraform module, provenance (signing), and a CI validation pipeline for marketplace ingestion. Can we put together a 45m lab + a repo they can fork?

owen_eng: yes. propose scope: 1) module skeleton (network, bucket, runtime role), 2) README quickstart + submit steps, 3) CI: fmt -> terrascan -> tf init/plan -> optional smoke (sandbox creds), 4) signing appendix using cosign. keep everything minimal.

tess_infra: i'll own the GH Actions templates and the terrascan baseline rules. plan: PR triggers: terraform fmt -> terrascan -> tf init/plan. for demo we'll show a separate workflow that cosign-signs the artifact and one that verifies before publish.

rui_docs: i'll write the partner README and a short "how to map your IAM" cheat-sheet. will add a troubleshooting section: provider mismatches, missing vars, common terrascan failures.

partner_vp: critical ask: our security/compliance team requires proof of provenance. they prefer sigstore/cosign over GPG. also want a note on HSM/KMS-backed keys for production.

owen_eng: agreed. demo snippet for signing flow (we'll show in slides):
```yaml
name: sign-module
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-and-sign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Package module
        run: tar -czf module.tgz ./modules/sample
      - name: Install cosign
        run: |
          curl -sSLf https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/latest/download/cosign-linux-amd64 -o cosign && chmod +x cosign && sudo mv cosign /usr/local/bin/
      - name: Sign artifact
        env:
          COSIGN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.COSIGN_PASSWORD }}
        run: cosign sign-blob --key ${{ secrets.COSIGN_KEY }} -o module.tgz.sig module.tgz
```

marie_partners: and verification snippet for marketplace ingestion?

tess_infra: yep, short verify step we can add to validate job:
```yaml
- name: Verify signature
  run: cosign verify-blob --key $COSIGN_PUB_KEY module.tgz.sig module.tgz
```

sig-bot: Note: Marketplace policy update  signed modules get a trust badge in UI; unsigned allowed but flagged.

rui_docs: i'll include a one-paragraph on how partners can store cosign keys in KMS/HSM and use envelope encryption. also add an "if you can't sign" fallback: publish as private bundle & run manual review.

ownen_eng: CI validation we'll demo (in slides):
```yaml
name: validate-module
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -d . -p policies/
      - name: Terraform Init & Plan
        run: terraform init -input=false && terraform plan -input=false
```

marie_partners: timeline: workshop Fri 11am PT. deliverables by Thu EOD: repo skeleton under redwood-partners/marketplace-provenance, sample module, GH Action templates, README draft. partners to RSVP by Wed.

partner_vp: thanks, include an appendix with hardware tuning notes (batch size, precision tips) but keep core quickstart hardware-agnostic.

tess_infra: action items: 1) repo skeleton + CI templates (tess) 2) terrascan baseline rules (tess) 3) README quickstart + mapping cheat-sheet (rui) 4) sample module + packaging script (owen). I'll provision demo keys for the session.

marie_partners: perfect. i'll send invites and the RSVP form. we'll reconvene Thu 10am to sanity-check the demo assets. :white_check_mark:
